description: Allows Charon agents to manage, list, and query top bar ticker tasks, scheduling, and operational checklists.
author: Charon Librarian

add_task.description: Add or pin a new task (title, priority, task_id) to the top bar ticker loop.

complete_task.description: Mark an existing task_id as completed to remove it from ticker rotation.

list_tasks.description: Query all currently active/pinned tasks from the top bar ticker loop.
